how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Raipur Research Associate-II Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Raipur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Raipur Research Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NIT Raipur Research Associate-II recruitment is 09 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-II position will receive a salary of Rs. 61,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology/Electronics and Communication Engineering/Computer Application/Computer Science or have 3 years of research experience after M.E./M.Tech. with at least one SCI/SCIE paper.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-II position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Research Associate-II in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate-II position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the Research Associate-II position is scheduled to be held on 14 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Chhattisgarh apply?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications from eligible candidates in Chhattisgarh. However, it is advisable to check the official notification for any specific residency requirements.
